title: few-parameter autokey crib-chain propagation
hypothesis: K4 is a plaintext/ciphertext autokey (few params) over a keyed alphabet
insights: Tested 55 autokey configs ((plaintext|ciphertext) x L=1-30 x 6 alphabets x 3 conventions); 55 were crib-consistent.

Best (>=40 non-crib positions derived): plaintext_autokey L=28 standard/vigenere, coverage 60/73, hexagram -24.13/char, smooth-LM -7.284. Derived plaintext: YGCKAZ?HCVGHDGEBRK???EASTNORTHEAST?MUYKLGKORNA???WTRRYGMPTSI...

No autokey family (plaintext- or ciphertext-keyed, any L<=30, standard or keyed alphabet, any convention) propagates the cribs into English. The crib chains either conflict (rejected) or derive gibberish. Few-parameter autokey is closed.
next_steps: try Gromark/running-key with text-derived primers; combine a short transposition with autokey (2-param composite)
